column1: # Entries are checked against Mozc src/data/preedit/romanji-hiragana.tsv (BSD-3-Clause, see NOTICE):
# every Mozc entry is present except 'n' and 'www' (handled by the converter). Nagi extras:
# n + consonant (see G-40), / ? ! ( ) and a few alternative spellings.
# Lines starting with # and empty lines are ignored
# Palatalized (sya, syu, syo) and direct forms (sha, shu, sho)
# Palatalized (tya, tyu, tyo) and direct forms (cha, chu, cho)
# Palatalized (jya, jyu, jyo) and direct forms (ja, ju, jo)
# Alternative spellings (shi, chi, tsu, fu, ji)
# ca, ci, cu, ce, co (alternative k-sounds)
# Small kana (xa, xi, xu, xe, xo / la, li, lu, le, lo)
# Small kana (xya, xyu, xyo / lya, lyu, lyo)
# n + consonant (mora n) - except y and vowel
# Mozc: sokuon for q l x y (qq, ll, xx, yy) and tch
# Mozc: c / q rows (cya, cye, qa...)
# Mozc: yi/ye extended palatalized (kyi, kye, gyi, ...)
# Mozc: small kana / ka ke (xka, xke, lka, lke)
# Mozc: w / wh rows (wu, wha, whi, whu, whe, who)
# Mozc: ts / th / dh / tw / dw rows
# Mozc: apostrophe forms (t'i, d'i, t'u, d'u, t'yu, d'yu)
# Mozc: kw / gw / sw / zw rows
# n + q/l/x (Nagi: same handling as other n + consonant)
